raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44535. A `stop_token_ids` entry outside `[0, vocab_size)` crashes the server as soon as any request in the batch has `min_new_tokens > 0`: `BatchedMinNewTokensPenalizer._prepare` scatters every stop id in the batch into a `[batch, vocab_size + 1]` tensor, and an out-of-range id is a device-side assert that takes down all in-flight requests. `verify()` already bounds `logit_bias` keys the same way, but not `stop_token_ids`.

The Rust server has the same gap. It replaces `TokenizerManager` and runs its own `SamplingParams::verify` (`rust/sglang-server/src/message/sampling.rs`), which mirrors the Python checks, including the `logit_bias` bound, but not this one. Requests it accepts reach the same scheduler and penalizer, so fixing only the Python path would leave Rust-server deployments exposed.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/sampling/sampling_params.py`: `verify()` rejects `stop_token_ids` outside `[0, vocab_size)` with a `ValueError`, next to the `logit_bias` check. `TokenizerManager` turns it into a 400.
- `rust/sglang-server/src/message/sampling.rs`: the same bound and message in `SamplingParams::verify`, so both frontends behave the same.
- Regression tests on both sides: ids at `vocab_size`, far above it, and negative are rejected; ids at `0` and `vocab_size - 1` are accepted.

`vocab_size` here is `model_config.vocab_size`, the same value the penalizer sizes its tensor with (`schedule_batch.py`), and `normalize()` does not add to `stop_token_ids`, so the check only rejects ids the client sent.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: request validation only; no change to model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A.

## Validation

- `test/registered/unit/sampling/test_sampling_params.py`: 79 passed. With the `sampling_params.py` change reverted, the 3 out-of-vocab cases fail.
- `cargo test -p sglang-server --lib message::sampling`: 27 passed. With the new check removed from `verify`, `stop_token_ids_are_vocab_bounded` fails.
- `pre-commit run` on the changed files passes (including `clippy` and `rustfmt` for the Rust workspace).

The end-to-end crash needs a GPU (it is a CUDA device-side assert), which I did not run; the tests above cover the validation that prevents it.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -315,6 +315,24 @@ def test_logit_bias_valid_tokens(self):
         sp = self._make(logit_bias={"0": 1.0, "31999": -0.5})
         sp.verify(self.VOCAB_SIZE)
 
+    # --- stop_token_ids ---
+    def test_stop_token_ids_out_of_vocab_raises(self):
+        """Out-of-vocab stop_token_ids must be rejected at request validation.
+
+        The min_new_tokens penalizer scatters every stop id in the batch into a
+        [batch, vocab_size + 1] tensor, so one out-of-range id crashed the server.
+        """
+        for token_id in (self.VOCAB_SIZE, 1_000_000, -1):
+            with self.subTest(token_id=token_id):
+                sp = self._make(stop_token_ids=[1, token_id])
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+                    sp.verify(self.VOCAB_SIZE)
+
+    def test_stop_token_ids_vocab_boundaries_accepted(self):
+        """Test that stop_token_ids at both ends of [0, vocab_size) are accepted."""
+        sp = self._make(stop_token_ids=[0, self.VOCAB_SIZE - 1])
+        sp.verify(self.VOCAB_SIZE)
+
     # --- sampling_seed ---
     def test_sampling_seed_valid(self):
         """Test that None (the default) and the int64 min/max boundaries are accepted."""
